newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Quarter of SAA flights delayed - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Quarter of SAA flights delayed - ministry.

text.p: Transport Minister Mac Maharaj on Monday confirmed what airline passengers have long suspected: Delays to South African Airways flights are regular.
Maharaj said in a written response to a parliamentary question that a quarter of all SAA flights were delayed by an average of 47 minutes in the first three months of 1997.

"Rotation" -- the late availability of the required aircraft -- was the cause of 1,081 of the 2,807 delays with technical factors responsible for 340 more and passengers for a further 221. Only 44 flights were delayed by bad weather.
